one_liner: Developed reusable front-end components for Capital One Travel's booking flows to support continuous UX and feature updates.
projectSummary: Built flexible, reusable front‑end components for Capital One Travel, supporting new booking flows, rewards interactions, and UI improvements across the platform.

problem.summary: Parts of the travel booking experience required clearer UI patterns, more consistent components, and updates to support new rewards-focused user flows.

goals: Support updates across booking and rewards flows
Improve clarity and consistency throughout travel modules
Translate complex interaction requirements into stable components
Enhance the design system with predictable, reusable UI patterns
responsibilities: Building modular React components aligned with Capital One’s design system
Working closely with designers to refine spacing, layout, and interaction details
Translating detailed Figma interactions into predictable front‑end behavior
Implementing responsive layouts across travel booking modules
Supporting design QA, iteration, and cross‑browser testing
Documenting component behavior and edge cases for the engineering team
outcomes: Delivered stable, reusable components used across updated travel booking flows
Improved clarity and interaction patterns for rewards and purchase modules
Strengthened consistency and alignment across teams working on the platform
